title: Turtle Rider in Enchanted Forest
description: A surreal night scene in a dark forest features a large green eye with a yellow fleur-de-lis iris floating in the sky. Below, an elderly man with a purple scarf and hat rides a large green turtle adorned with fleur-de-lis symbols while holding a glowing orb.
prompt: A surreal night forest scene with dark twisted trees and purple ground. In the center of the sky floats a giant stylized green eye with a yellow fleur-de-lis iris containing small figures and stars. In the foreground an old man with glasses, hat and purple patterned scarf rides a large green turtle covered in fleur-de-lis symbols, holding a glowing orb in his hands. Mystical glowing elements, small figures in the trees, purple and yellow lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere.
